label: .NET migration drift (EF Core)
description: dotnet ef migrations has-pending-model-changes (the tools image's dotnet-ef) tells whether the model changed since the last migration. Comes in by evidence: a Migrations/*ModelSnapshot.cs; runs only where migration is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Needs a services section in jgates.yml and tools.<id>.databaseUrl; without services it is SERVICES_REQUIRED, never a blocker.
